what_happened: In job 85mv, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The job moves readers of records/ to a records worktree. The reading missed two live readers: the land_pr code in gh.rs (around line 2513), which loads Records at HEAD to resolve a job, and the directory walks in introspect.rs (around lines 300-360). The user asked that both files be moved and listed. The user also asked that the scan catch fully qualified calls such as crate::store::Records::load(, not only the short form.
cause: The reading is built from the request text and never checked against the code. Nothing finds every real reader of records/ (direct loads, directory walks, qualified call paths) before the reading is accepted. So the deliverable list and the scan pattern reflect what the reading assumed. Only the user knows which readers exist, so the same correction comes back on each reading in this family. The previous case s7mw, on the same records/ move, was an over-broad scope. This one is an under-broad scope.
prevention: Before a reading is accepted, run a check on a request that moves or reroots a path. It searches the code for every access to that path: loads, directory walks, and fully qualified or aliased calls. It compares the hits with the reading's deliverables and scan pattern. It flags any file with a real reader that the reading omits, and any scan pattern that matches only the short call form. It also separates real readers from citation strings. The reading is then refused or amended until the file list and the scan match what the code does.
